value.definition_catalyst: Wood is your Body, and running thin, it is the growth reserve your whole system draws on: appetite, stamina, the will to start things. When it dips you feel it as flatness before you feel it as fatigue.
value.definition_friction: Wood is your Body, and running over, it is more growing force than your life gives outlets: restlessness, overcommitment, energy that starts five things just to spend itself.
value.advise_catalyst: Vitality is grown, never summoned. Get daylight before noon, move every day even briefly, keep green things and green places near you. Protect one truly free evening a week. Start one small thing and let finishing it feed the next.
value.advise_friction: Force without direction becomes pressure on the vessel. Spend it hard and on purpose: train until tired, walk far, build with your hands. Cap active projects at two. When restlessness spikes, exercise before you commit to anything new.

value.definition_catalyst: Fire is your Expression, and as a catalyst, it is where what you have built becomes visible: presenting, hosting, putting your name on the work. Visibility feeds you more than you expect.
value.definition_friction: Fire is your Expression, and as a friction, it is visibility outrunning capacity: announcing early, performing energy you do not have, saying yes on stage and paying for it offstage.
value.advise_catalyst: Light is part of how work finishes. Show one finished thing a week, publicly and on purpose. Say yes to the toast, the talk, the intro. When something stalls, share it half-done and let being seen restart it.
value.advise_friction: An audience is a loan against tomorrow. Borrow less: pull the launch dates back by half, decline one appearance a month, and let the next thing be seen only when it is done. Practice being unimpressive in safe company.

value.definition_catalyst: Earth is your Action, and as a catalyst, it is where your reach becomes something held: savings, property, positions, commitments that stay put. You do best when ambition lands somewhere concrete.
value.definition_friction: Earth is your Action, and as a friction, it is holding past your means: too many commitments owned, maintained, and defended at once, each taxing energy you no longer have spare. Everything you keep charges rent on you.
value.advise_catalyst: Ownership is ambition slowed down enough to keep. Automate a monthly amount into one long-term asset and stop renegotiating it. Review what you hold twice a year. Add slowly, and only what you intend to keep for a decade.
value.advise_friction: Lightness is also a form of wealth. Sell, delegate, or close one standing obligation this month. Before acquiring anything, name its yearly cost in hours. Keep a short list of what you would defend in a hard year, and loosen everything off it.

value.definition_catalyst: Metal is your Order, and as a catalyst, it is the standard that shapes your growth: editors, coaches, reviews, rules you chose on purpose. You improve fastest under exacting eyes.
value.definition_friction: Metal is your Order, and as a friction, it is correction landing harder than you can absorb: every rule met, every critique taken, until standards stop shaping you and start shrinking you. The harshest voice you hear ends up being your own.
value.advise_catalyst: Growth loves resistance it respects. Put your work in front of one demanding person on a schedule, monthly at least. Ask for the harshest note first. Treat every review on the calendar as training, never as threat.
value.advise_friction: Standards should serve the thing growing, never the other way around. Keep the two judges whose notes make you better and mute the rest. Answer critique after a night, never in the hour. Break one harmless rule a month to remember you can.

value.definition_catalyst: Water is your Mind, and as a catalyst, it is how you refill: quiet intake, reading, long conversations, time alone that lets impressions settle into understanding. Your thinking improves in direct proportion to your rest.
value.definition_friction: Water is your Mind, and as a friction, it is intake past the point of use: one more book, one more opinion, reflection turning into stalling. More input now costs you clarity instead of adding it.
value.advise_catalyst: Understanding arrives on its own schedule and only through an open door. Hold one screen-free hour before bed. Take the walk before the decision. Keep a note of what surfaces there, because it will be the truest thinking you do.
value.advise_friction: A mind can also overwater. Close the intake and let what you know settle: set a decision date and honor it, act on the last book before opening the next, and take one full day a week with nothing new coming in.

value.definition_catalyst: Wood is your Mind, and as a catalyst, it is how your fuel accumulates: skills stacked, books finished, friendships tended, people learned from over years. What you gather quietly becomes what you later spend as brilliance.
value.definition_friction: Wood is your Mind, and as a friction, it is more fuel than one flame can use: courses, books, mentors, plans, all of it feeding a fire that burns hotter than it burns long.
value.advise_catalyst: Brilliance is mostly patience with good storage. Keep one slow project that grows monthly, a course, a craft, a language, and refuse to rush it. Finish books. Choose one person to learn from properly this year and stay teachable.
value.advise_friction: You start more than you finish. Finish the one project closest to done this month, as it is, and let it ship at eighty percent. Put every new course, book or plan on a list until that one is out. When the urge to start something rises, ask which unfinished thing it would replace.

value.definition_catalyst: Fire is your Body, and running thin, it is the energy behind your warmth: sociability, drive, the lift that makes mornings possible. Yours runs in bursts, so depletion shows as dimness with people you love.
value.definition_friction: Fire is your Body, and running over, it is more heat than your days can spend: sleep that will not come, intensity leaking into every conversation, rest that feels like a punishment.
value.advise_catalyst: A light that never recharges becomes an act. Schedule recovery like meetings: real breaks between social blocks, daylight before screens, one morning a week with no one to perform for. Cancel something small today and feel what returns.
value.advise_friction: Heat needs somewhere honest to go or it goes everywhere. Train to actual sweat most days. Keep one evening a week completely unplanned and endure it. Put the phone down an hour before bed and let the engine actually idle.

value.definition_catalyst: Earth is your Expression, and as a catalyst, it is your heat becoming things that last: lessons taught, systems written down, gatherings that become traditions. You are at your best converting enthusiasm into something others can stand on.
value.definition_friction: Earth is your Expression, and as a friction, it is making monuments out of moments: every idea formalized, every project turned permanent, output hardening while your energy thins.
value.advise_catalyst: Enthusiasm fades, structure remembers. After every burst of inspiration, spend one hour making it hold: a document, a recipe, a repeatable plan. Host the gathering twice and it becomes tradition. Write down the thing you keep explaining.
value.advise_friction: Some warmth is meant to be spent, never stored. Let the next good idea stay a conversation. Retire one system you maintain out of habit. Pour your building energy into the single structure that actually matters this year, and let the rest be evenings.

value.definition_catalyst: Metal is your Action, and as a catalyst, it is your heat applied to hard, valuable problems: negotiations, difficult skills, work that resists until it yields. Easy tasks waste you.
value.definition_friction: Metal is your Action, and as a friction, it is reworking what should be finished: renegotiating settled things, polishing shipped work, effort spent softening what was already solid. Done is a decision you keep reopening.
value.advise_catalyst: Difficulty is your natural price filter, so use it openly. Take the assignment everyone else avoids. Price your work higher than feels comfortable and let the discomfort season. Once a year, pick one skill hard enough to embarrass you for months.
value.advise_friction: Finished things are load-bearing, so stop testing them. Close three open loops this week and do not reopen them. Give every task a final pass, then a lock. Aim the reworking energy at one genuinely unsolved problem instead.

value.definition_catalyst: Water is your Order, and as a catalyst, it is the cool check your intensity needs: reviews, budgets, one person whose calm questions slow you down before the leap. Your best decisions have all survived a night of doubt.
value.definition_friction: Water is your Order, and as a friction, it is caution soaking through everything: every plan reviewed until the moment passes, every spark second-guessed into a maybe. The checking now costs more than the mistakes would, and the hardest judge of the flame is you.
value.advise_catalyst: Discipline, for you, is imported, so import it well. Sleep on anything irreversible. Keep a reviewer you cannot charm and show them everything big. Put a cool number on every hot plan before saying yes.
value.advise_friction: Prudence past its dose becomes fear with a clipboard. Give small decisions a five-minute timer. Reserve real review for the truly irreversible. Once a month, act on a warm impulse the same day it arrives and audit the result later.

value.definition_catalyst: Wood is your Order, and as a catalyst, it is living obligation that keeps you growing: family, teams, mentees, commitments that grow back each season and ask you to grow with them. Care is your discipline.
value.definition_friction: Wood is your Order, and as a friction, it is obligations multiplying past your ground: everyone rooted in you, nothing rooted for you, care extracted faster than it regrows. Fall short once and the harshest judgement comes from inside.
value.advise_catalyst: Some people are structured by rules. You are structured by what you tend. Take on one responsibility that develops over years and let its calendar anchor yours. Show up on its schedule especially when you do not feel like it.
value.advise_friction: Care that never rests its fields goes barren. List who actually needs you this season and hand one standing duty back, kindly and completely. Say a full yes to fewer things. Plant something that feeds you and give it the best hour.

value.definition_catalyst: Fire is your Mind, and as a catalyst, it is how learning actually enters you: through excitement, people, and live example rather than cold text. You retain what warmed you. Affection, praise, and festivity all count as study.
value.definition_friction: Fire is your Mind, and as a friction, it is stimulation mistaken for nourishment: feeds, sparks, novelty consumed all day while real understanding stays shallow. The excitement is spending you, and it feels like input.
value.advise_catalyst: For you, warmth is a study technique. Take the class instead of the book. Explain new ideas to someone within a day of meeting them. Learn beside people on purpose, and let excitement pick the syllabus more often than duty does.
value.advise_friction: Attention is the meal, and yours is being eaten as snacks. Cut the feeds to one sitting a day. Give the freed hour to one slow subject and stay a month. Let yourself be bored on purpose until depth becomes interesting again.

value.definition_catalyst: Earth is your Body, and running thin, it is the steadiness under everything: digestion, sleep depth, the physical calm that lets you carry weight. Yours erodes quietly under skipped meals and moved bedtimes.
value.definition_friction: Earth is your Body, and running over, it is heaviness accumulating: routines hardened into ruts, comfort eaten past comfort, a body built for staying that now resists moving.
value.advise_catalyst: Stability is a practice before it is a trait. Rebuild with boring regularity: same waking hour, real lunches eaten sitting down, one slow day a week defended like an appointment. Let others see you rest so they learn to expect it.
value.advise_friction: Steadiness needs motion the way ground needs rain. Walk daily at the same hour until it is simply weather. Change one fixed habit each season purely to prove you can. Say yes to one invitation a month that mildly inconveniences you.

value.definition_catalyst: Metal is your Expression, and as a catalyst, it is your patience surfacing as precision: the exact word, the finished piece, the standard people quote after you leave. You speak rarely and it lands.
value.definition_friction: Metal is your Expression, and as a friction, it is output demanded from reserves that fill slowly: more deliverables, more opinions, more polish than your quiet depth can supply. Producing is starting to hollow you.
value.advise_catalyst: Scarcity is part of your signal, and shipping is the other part. Ship one polished thing a month, small is fine, finished is the point. Keep a file of your exact sentences. Volunteer the summary when talk runs long.
value.advise_friction: A slow well serves best when it is pumped rarely. Halve your output commitments for a quarter. Let the remaining work carry your full standard. Answer fewer threads, and let silence do some of your talking again.

value.definition_catalyst: Water is your Action, and as a catalyst, it is moving value passing through your steady hands: money, opportunities, people in motion who need somewhere reliable to land. You profit by being the stable point in a moving system.
value.definition_friction: Water is your Action, and as a friction, it is managing flows you no longer need to manage: accounts checked daily, opportunities tracked past usefulness, control spending the calm it was meant to protect.
value.advise_catalyst: Value moves toward whoever moves it cleanly. Keep a fixed monthly review of what flows through you, income, offers, introductions, and route each one deliberately. Answer the forwardable email same-day. Save a fixed share of every inflow first.
value.advise_friction: A well-built channel does not need a warden. Automate the transfers and check monthly, on one fixed day. Archive whatever sat watched but untouched for ninety days. Let one week a quarter pass entirely unmonitored, and spend the attention on something that cannot be refreshed.

value.definition_catalyst: Your Action is what you go and build, claim and provide. Wood makes it grow, so what you build adds up. As a catalyst, your hands sit empty, so you want the next opening as much as a steady love. You build best once you choose one and finish it.
value.definition_friction: Your Action is what you go and build, claim and provide. Wood keeps it reaching, so building never feels done. As a friction, wanting outruns strength, so you chase the next venture while holding your savings just as tight. Keep in mind that you run out before your plans do.
value.advise_catalyst: You get hardest on yourself when your strength has nothing to build. Give it something. Agree to one venture before you are sure. Put a date on the saving you keep putting off. Fix one thing at home with your own hands, and write the first line of the plan tonight.
value.advise_friction: You start more than your body has strength to finish. Sleep a full night before any new yes. Eat before you plan the next thing. Seek Metal, your own Body energy. Metal is what stays when the wanting stops, the rest under the effort. Let it hold what Wood pours out.

value.definition_catalyst: Your Order is the rules you answer to and the rank you hold by them. Fire makes it fuel, so demands shape you. As a catalyst, nothing tests you, so you want a crisis as much as a rank to keep. You get most done under rules someone else set.
value.definition_friction: Your Order is the rules you answer to and the rank you hold by them. Fire lights it, so rules reach you. As a friction, pressure piles up, so you obey a crisis ahead of rest and rules ahead of judgment. Remember that you mistake pressure on yourself for discipline.
value.advise_catalyst: You do your best work when someone is allowed to tell you no. Pick one job this month that comes with a deadline and a judge, and ship it on time. Make the hard call out loud in front of the people it affects. Finish one small thing before anyone has to chase you for it.
value.advise_friction: You answer to pressure faster than you recover from it. Read the whole message before you answer the next hard call. Keep one evening a week with nobody to report to. Seek Earth, the Mind energy. Earth takes the blaze in and keeps it as warmth, ground that does not catch. Let it hold what Fire burns.

value.definition_catalyst: Your Mind is where the world soaks in and becomes yours. Earth makes it steady, so what you learn sinks in. As a catalyst, nothing settles for long, so you work it out alone rather than lean on anyone. You judge best once you give a question its night.
value.definition_friction: Your Mind is where the world soaks in and becomes yours. Earth holds it, so nothing you learn is lost. As a friction, the holding never stops, so you learn ahead of deciding and stay sheltered ahead of letting go. Remember that you sit on finished work past its time.
value.advise_catalyst: Your judgment is only as good as the time you let it take in. Read one book slowly instead of five fast. Ask the oldest person you trust how they would do it, and hear them out to the end. Keep one evening a week with no one in it. Sleep on anything that costs money.
value.advise_friction: Getting ready is your most comfortable way of not starting. Decide one thing you have read enough about. Send the rough version to someone before the clean one exists. Seek Wood, the Action energy. Wood grows from the ground that fed it, a thing built, a start made before the reading is done. Let it spend what Earth stores.

value.definition_catalyst: Your Body is the strength the whole of you stands on. Metal makes it hard, so your will holds. Running thin, strength gives out, so you stand alone rather than lean on a peer and bet big rather than rest. You last longest once you let rest and company in.
value.definition_friction: Your Body is the strength the whole of you stands on. Metal keeps it exact, so your standard holds. Running over, your will sits unused, so you trust your call more than a peer's and fight over every shared stake. Remember that you trade a peer for each argument won.
value.advise_catalyst: You treat rest as something you earn after the work instead of the thing the work runs on. Take rest in first and sleep before the hard decision rather than after it. Let one peer carry a job you could do yourself. Sit out one contest a month on purpose. Eat before you answer the message.
value.advise_friction: Being right is how you stay in charge of yourself. Ship one finished thing to someone above you by their date. Say your plan to someone who can refuse it. Seek Fire, the Order energy. Fire is heat with a deadline: it gives your force a direction and a judge. Let it spend what Metal stores.

value.definition_catalyst: Your Expression is the gate where inner work becomes outer fact. Water makes it flow, so what you feel gets said. As a catalyst, your gate stays shut, so you would rather get a thing right than give it. You keep your kindness and your wit waiting past their moment.
value.definition_friction: Your Expression is the gate where inner work becomes outer fact. Water pours it out, so nothing you feel stays in. As a friction, the gate never shuts, so you give more than you keep and say more than you know. Remember that you run empty before you run quiet.
value.advise_catalyst: You keep being right in private, and that counts for nothing until someone hears it. Send the page before the third read. Tell a child one story with no lesson in it. Once a month, give something you made to someone who did not ask. Say the compliment the moment you think it.
value.advise_friction: You say the thing to find out what you think, and nothing is left over for you. Read a whole chapter before you answer. Sit with one question overnight. Seek Earth, the Mind energy. Earth is the bank and the ground: it takes water in and holds it until it clears. Let it hold what Water pours.

value.definition_catalyst: Wood is your Expression, and as a catalyst, it is your depth showing up as things that grow: people mentored, ideas seeded, projects that stand up and keep growing after you step back. You are built to develop others.
value.definition_friction: Wood is your Expression, and as a friction, it is pouring into everything that stands still: every person developed, every idea watered, your depth spent raising gardens you do not live in.
value.advise_catalyst: Influence, for you, is slow, patient, and alive. Take one mentee, one junior, one growing thing, and give it a standing hour a week. Seed ideas freely and follow up seasonally. Keep a quiet list of what you have grown.
value.advise_friction: Generosity without limits feeds no one well for long. Count what you are currently growing, keep the three that matter, and let the rest go. Decline one mentorship ask a month. Water something of yours first, every single week.

value.definition_catalyst: Fire is your Action, and as a catalyst, it is the bright opportunity your judgment was built to run: launches, markets, moments that reward the person who read them early. You see clearly where others squint.
value.definition_friction: Fire is your Action, and as a friction, it is urgency pulling on a system that runs deep and slow: hot chances chased, quick pivots made, each one costing more recovery than it returns. Fast money is expensive for you.
value.advise_catalyst: A gift for timing is wasted on a spectator. When your read says now, commit within a week instead of watching it prove you right. Size the bet so a miss stings without sinking. Keep one bright project live at all times.
value.advise_friction: Your edge is patience, so defend it from excitement. Let two opportunities pass for every one you take. Take only what survives a week of waiting. Keep a cooling-off rule for anything urgent, because urgency is usually someone else’s deadline.

value.definition_catalyst: Earth is your Order, and as a catalyst, it is the structure that turns your depth into force: fixed roles, steady schedules, commitments that do not move with your moods. You are most creative inside walls you chose.
value.definition_friction: Earth is your Order, and as a friction, it is structure tightening past usefulness: a calendar with no slack, roles held from duty long after they stopped fitting, routine squeezing out the responsiveness you actually run on. Miss one duty and the sternest voice you hear is your own.
value.advise_catalyst: Choose your structure and the rest takes care of itself. Anchor the week with three fixed blocks, same day, same hour, and let everything fluid arrange around them. Accept the role with the schedule. Keep the routine two weeks past the urge to quit.
value.advise_friction: A schedule should hold your life, never replace it. Leave one afternoon a week unscheduled and guard the emptiness. Renegotiate the obligation you dread most. Each quarter, drop one commitment that survives on habit alone.

value.definition_catalyst: Metal is your Mind, and as a catalyst, it is precision feeding your depth: exact teachers, rigorous methods, clean tools that turn vague knowing into usable clarity. You think better with structure than with more input.
value.definition_friction: Metal is your Mind, and as a friction, it is rigor calcifying: frameworks collected, systems perfected, understanding organized so thoroughly it never gets used. The structure is displacing the thinking.
value.advise_catalyst: Structure is what makes your depth spendable. Learn one exact discipline properly, notation, code, a method, and let it organize everything else you know. Write definitions for the words you use most. Choose teachers stricter than your mood.
value.advise_friction: Method is scaffolding, and scaffolding is meant to come down. Skip the new framework this month. Take what you already know and apply it somewhere messy. Once a week, think on paper with no system at all and see what you actually believe.

value.definition_catalyst: Water is your Body, and running thin, it is the deep reserve under your perception: sleep quality, quiet time, the stillness your system restores itself in. Yours drains invisibly, through noise and company, long before you feel tired.
value.definition_friction: Water is your Body, and running over, it is stillness pooling into stagnation: rest that no longer restores, sleep that stretches without refreshing, energy waiting for a current that never comes.
value.advise_catalyst: Solitude is your maintenance, so dose it like medicine. One silent hour daily, no inputs. A full day alone each month, calendared in advance. Leave gatherings while they are still good, and let the quiet finish what the rest began.
value.advise_friction: Depth stays fresh by moving. Add motion that flows, swimming, walking, cycling, and make one weekly commitment that gets you out the door regardless of mood. Say yes before the mood votes. Stir the water and watch the energy remember itself.
